sections.text: Is closed to southbound traffic at Lake Hughes Rd (Los Angeles Co) - Due to a road hazard - Motorists are advised to use an alternate route Southbound traffic is reduced to 1 lane at San Fernando Mission Blvd /in San Fernando/ (Los Angeles Co) - Due to a jackknifed big rig

A high wind advisory is in effect from the Los Angeles/Kern Co Line to 5 mi south of the Jct of SR-99 /at Grapevine Rd/ (Kern Co) /the Grapevine/ - Travel is not recommended for campers, trailers, or permit loads
A high wind advisory is in effect from the Stanislaus/San Joaquin Co Line to the San Joaquin/Sacramento Co Line - Travel is not recommended for campers, trailers, or permit loads
